APA-style references added to all five source records. Opened McGill, Live Science and Cornell pages; ACS content was available in the search result but direct page access returned 403, and WSU source text was available in search results. Treat the ACS/WSU direct-page access limitation as retrieval limitation, not as an unverified factual claim.

Corrected earlier advice that chilling onions reduces tears: a 2025 report states chilled onions released more tear-triggering droplets in the reported tests. Recommend a sharp blade and slower cutting instead.
